dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and '8' shaped light-grey annuli are visible against a dark-charcoal background. The perimeters consist of thin, high-contrast light boundaries with a gradient transition from the dark exterior coat to a lighter grey interior within the ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-grey pixel clusters localized primarily on the lower lateral flank and near the anterior flipper; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as high-contrast speckling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the figure-eight annulus and two adjacent 'C' shaped structures on the upper right quadrant form a scalene triangle. A set of three high-intensity blobs on the lower midsection forms a nearly equilateral geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique figure-eight or 'infinity' shaped marking composed of two conjoined high-contrast annuli on the upper right lateral-dorsal surface.
